about: Clay sprites of Ian and Ember. Made by art/clay/tools; do not edit by hand.

duo/belly-rub.about: He kneels beside her scratching her belly with both hands, laughing; she lies on her back, wriggling in bliss, one back leg kicking the air.

duo/carry.about: He carries her in both arms like a giant baby, leaning back and staggering under her weight; she looks delighted.

duo/greet.about: He stands upright, laughing; she stands up on her back legs with her front paws on his chest, licking his chin.

duo/high-five.about: He crouches holding one palm out; she sits and slaps a front paw onto it, a high five.

duo/hug.about: He crouches with both arms around her neck in a big hug, eyes closed; she sits and licks his cheek, knocking his glasses crooked.

duo/movie.about: Seen from directly BEHIND: the two sit side by side on the floor, his arm around her shoulders, both looking away from the camera into the distance.

duo/pals.about: He stands upright facing the camera with his arms folded, grinning; she sits beside him facing the camera, tongue out.

duo/squash.about: He lies flat on his stomach, squashed, arms spread, glasses crooked, chin on the floor; she sits proudly on his back, tongue out.

duo/stand.about: He stands upright facing the camera with one hand resting on her head; she stands on all four legs beside him, looking up at him.

duo/tug.about: Tug of war, seen from the side: he leans back pulling one end of a white sock with two black stripes with both hands; she faces him, rump low, pulling the other end in her teeth.

duo/walk.about: Walking together, side view facing right: he strolls with his hands in his jeans pockets; she trots at his side looking up at him.

ember/ball-down.about: Lying down, side view facing right, guarding a yellow tennis ball between her front paws.

ember/beg.about: Sitting up on her haunches facing the camera, front paws tucked at her chest, head tilted, pleading.

ember/belly.about: Lying on her back, seen from the side, belly up, all four paws flopped in the air, head lolling toward the camera, tongue hanging out, blissful.

ember/bow.about: Play bow, side view facing right: chest and elbows flat on the ground, rump high in the air, tail wagging, cheeky grin.

ember/chew.about: Lying down, side view facing right, gnawing happily on a cream-coloured bone held upright between her front paws.

ember/dig.about: Digging furiously, side view facing right: head down, front paws scrabbling at the ground, rump up.

ember/down.about: Lying down sphinx-style, side view facing right: belly on the ground, front paws stretched out ahead, head up and alert.

ember/guilty.about: Lying flat, side view facing right, chin pressed to the ground between her front paws, ears drooping, eyes rolled up in a guilty look.

ember/howl.about: Sitting, side view facing right, nose pointed straight up at the sky, howling, mouth a small O.

ember/jump-catch.about: Leaping straight up, side view facing right, to catch something: body nearly vertical, front paws tucked to her chest, head thrown back, mouth wide open.

ember/jump-crouch.about: Coiled to spring, side view facing right: rump down, chest low, front paws planted, eyes locked on something above and ahead.

ember/jump-land.about: Landing from a leap, side view facing right: front paws touching down first, rump and back legs still high in the air.

ember/jump-leap.about: Mid-air in a long leap, side view facing right: body stretched full length, front paws reaching forward, back legs trailing, ears streaming back.

ember/lick.about: Facing the camera very close, giving it a big sloppy lick: huge pink tongue stretched up toward the viewer, eyes happy.

ember/look-up.about: Sitting facing the camera, head tipped right back to stare straight up at the sky, mouth a little open, waiting for something to fall.

ember/paws-up.about: Standing up on her back legs facing the camera, front paws hooked over an invisible ledge at chest height, peering over it.

ember/pounce.about: Pouncing, side view facing right: front paws together stabbing down at the ground, rump and tail high, ears up.

ember/roll.about: Half-way through rolling over, seen from the side: on her shoulder and side, legs kicking in the air, ears flopped on the ground, wriggling.

ember/run-1.about: Galloping flat out, side view facing right, at full stretch with all four paws off the ground: front legs reaching far forward, back legs kicked out behind, ears streaming back, tongue out.

ember/run-2.about: Galloping flat out, side view facing right, the gathered pose: all four paws bunched together under her arched body, ears flying up.

ember/scratch.about: Sitting facing the camera at a slight angle, scratching behind her ear with a back paw, eyes half shut in bliss.

ember/shake.about: Shaking herself off, facing the camera: whole coat twisting, ears and jowls flung out to one side, eyes squeezed shut.

ember/sit.about: Sitting upright facing the camera, front paws together, happy open-mouth smile, tongue showing.

ember/sit-side.about: Sitting upright, side view facing right, looking straight ahead, mouth closed, tail curled on the ground behind her.

ember/skid.about: Skidding to a stop, side view facing right: front legs braced stiff out in front, rump dropped low, ears flung forward, eyes wide.

ember/sleep.about: Curled up tight in a doughnut, fast asleep, nose tucked against her tail, eyes closed.

ember/sniff.about: Walking slowly, side view facing right, nose pressed to the ground, following a scent, tail up.

ember/sock-proud.about: Standing on all four legs, side view facing right, holding a white striped sock in her mouth.

ember/sock-run.about: Galloping away, side view facing right, with a white sock with two black stripes dangling from her mouth, ears flying, gleeful and guilty.

ember/soggy.about: Sitting facing the camera, soaked through: her curls flattened and hanging in wet strings, ears limp, thoroughly miserable.

ember/spin.about: Chasing her own tail, seen from the side: body bent into a tight C, nose almost catching the tip of her tail.

ember/stand.about: Standing square on all four legs, side view facing right, head up, mouth closed, calm.

ember/stand-2.about: Standing square on all four legs, side view facing right, head up, mouth open in a pant.

ember/stand-ball.about: Standing on all four legs, side view facing right, proudly holding a yellow tennis ball in her mouth, tail high.

ember/stand-bark.about: Standing on all four legs, side view facing right, head lifted, barking, mouth open.

ember/stand-look.about: Standing on all four legs, body turned three-quarters toward the camera, looking at the camera with a happy open mouth.

ember/stand-tilt.about: Standing on all four legs facing the camera, head cocked far to one side, one ear dangling, curious.

ember/stand-wag.about: Standing on all four legs, side view facing right, looking back over her shoulder at the camera, tail wagging.

ember/stick.about: Trotting, side view facing right, head held high, carrying a long brown stick crosswise in her mouth.

ember/trot-1.about: Trotting, side view facing right: one front leg and the opposite back leg stepping forward, tail up, cheerful.

ember/trot-2.about: Trotting, side view facing right, the opposite step: the other front leg and the other back leg forward.

ember/zoomies.about: Zoomies, side view facing right: sprinting low with her rump tucked under, eyes wide and wild, ears pinned back, tongue flapping.

ian/back.about: Seen from directly BEHIND: standing with his hands in his jeans pockets, looking away from the camera, hood hanging down his back.

ian/call.about: Crouched, side view facing right, slapping both hands on his knees to call the dog over, big encouraging smile.

ian/checklist.about: Standing facing the camera, holding a clipboard in one hand and ticking it with a pencil in the other, satisfied.

ian/cheer.about: Jumping for joy facing the camera, both fists punched in the air, huge open-mouth grin.

ian/climb.about: Hauling himself up over an invisible ledge, facing the camera: both forearms flat on top of it, chin just above, one knee hooked up beside him, straining.

ian/cold.about: Standing facing the camera with his hood UP over his head, hugging himself tightly, shoulders hunched, knees together, shivering.

ian/dance-1.about: Dancing, facing the camera: hips out to one side, one arm pointing up to the sky, the other pointing down, happy.

ian/dance-2.about: Dancing, facing the camera: the mirror move, hips out the other way, both arms bent in a goofy shuffle, one foot off the floor.

ian/facepalm.about: Standing facing the camera with one hand flat over his face, shoulders slumped.

ian/hang.about: Dangling at full stretch, facing the camera: both arms straight up above his head, hands curled as if gripping the edge of something that is NOT drawn, body and legs hanging loose, looking down nervously.

ian/hot.about: Standing facing the camera, wilting in the heat: fanning his face with one hand, the other arm hanging limp, tongue out, eyelids drooping. He is wearing his usual thick black rectangular glasses.

ian/jump-crouch.about: Winding up for a big jump, side view facing right: deep crouch, knees bent, arms swung far back, eyes fixed ahead.

ian/jump-land.about: Landing from a jump, side view facing right: deep squat, one hand touching the ground, the other arm out for balance.

ian/jump-leap.about: Mid-air in a long jump, side view facing right: body stretched out, both arms reaching forward, legs trailing behind, hood flapping.

ian/jump-tuck.about: Mid-air in a joyful jump, facing the camera: knees pulled up, both arms thrown up, mouth open laughing.

ian/kneel-pet.about: Kneeling on one knee, side view facing right, leaning forward with one hand reaching down and forward, fingers wiggling, as if scratching a dog's belly, smiling.

ian/laptop.about: Sitting cross-legged, facing the camera at a slight angle, a plain silver laptop open on his lap, typing, absorbed. The laptop lid is completely blank: no logo, no symbol, no sticker.

ian/late.about: Standing facing the camera, staring at the wristwatch on his raised forearm, eyebrows shot up, mouth a small O: he is late.

ian/laugh.about: Doubled over laughing, facing the camera at a slight angle, one arm across his belly, the other hand slapping his knee, eyes squeezed shut.

ian/lie-chin.about: Lying on his stomach, side view facing right, propped on his elbows with his chin in his hands, feet kicked up behind him, daydreaming.

ian/nap.about: Lying flat on his back, seen from the side, hands behind his head, one knee up, eyes closed, fast asleep.

ian/point.about: Pointing ahead with his whole arm, side view facing right, other hand cupped at his mouth as he shouts, excited.

ian/popcorn.about: Sitting cross-legged facing the camera, hugging a red-and-white striped popcorn bucket, tossing one piece of popcorn toward his open mouth.

ian/run-1.about: Running flat out, side view facing right, at full stretch with both feet off the ground: front leg reaching far forward, back leg kicked up behind, arms pumping, grinning.

ian/run-2.about: Running flat out, side view facing right, the passing pose: one foot planted on the ground under his body, the other knee lifted high in front, arms swapped.

ian/sit-edge.about: Sitting on an invisible ledge, facing the camera, legs dangling and feet swinging, hands resting on the edge beside him, content.

ian/skid.about: Skidding to a stop, side view facing right, leaning back, heels dug in, arms windmilling, eyebrows up in alarm.

ian/sneak.about: Sneaking on exaggerated tiptoe, side view facing right, knees high, shoulders hunched, one finger to his lips.

ian/stand.about: Standing upright and relaxed, facing the camera, arms at his sides, warm half-smile.

ian/stand-coffee.about: Standing upright facing the camera, holding a white coffee mug in both hands at his chest, sleepy contented smile.

ian/stand-phone.about: Standing upright facing the camera, looking down at a phone held in one hand at his chest, thumb scrolling.

ian/stand-proud.about: Standing upright facing the camera, hands on his hips, proud grin.

ian/stand-shrug.about: Standing upright facing the camera, shrugging: shoulders up, palms turned up at shoulder height, eyebrows raised.

ian/stand-thumbs.about: Standing upright facing the camera, giving a thumbs-up at chest height, pleased.

ian/stand-wave.about: Standing upright facing the camera, one open hand raised beside his head in a friendly wave, smiling.

ian/sunny.about: Standing facing the camera in dark sunglasses instead of his usual glasses, holding an iced coffee with a straw, relaxed and cool.

ian/throw-1.about: Winding up to throw a ball, side view facing right: weight on the back foot, throwing arm cocked far behind him, front arm pointing ahead. His hand is cupped but EMPTY: no ball.

ian/throw-2.about: Just after the throw, side view facing right: lunging forward, throwing arm flung out in front, hand open and EMPTY, back foot off the ground.

ian/umbrella.about: Standing facing the camera under an open bright red umbrella that he holds above his head, glancing up at the sky.

ian/walk-1.about: Walking, side view facing right, at the widest point of a stride: legs wide apart like open scissors, front heel just touching down, back foot on its toes, arms swinging opposite to the legs.

ian/walk-2.about: Walking, side view facing right, the passing pose: standing tall on one straight leg, the other knee bent with its foot lifted just off the ground beside it, both arms hanging close to his sides.

ian/windy.about: Leaning hard into a strong wind, side view facing right, one arm raised to shield his face, hood and drawstrings streaming out behind him.

ian/yawn.about: Standing facing the camera in a big morning stretch: both arms up and out, back arched, eyes shut, mouth wide in a huge yawn. He is wearing his usual thick black rectangular glasses.

props/ball.about: A yellow tennis ball with a white seam.

props/bowl.about: A red dog bowl heaped with brown kibble.

props/frisbee.about: A bright orange frisbee, tilted as if flying.

props/poof.about: A puffy white dust cloud, the kind kicked up by a landing.

props/sock.about: A limp white sports sock with two black stripes around the cuff.

props/stick.about: A knobbly brown stick, lying level.

props/zed.about: A single chunky lavender capital letter Z, for snoring.
